overview_description.description: ZOKO connects businesses to Whatsapp and Facebook Messenger for sending notifications, marketing, and conversational commerce. The company's dashboard enables them to provide the best possible experience for customers and prospects on WhatsApp, while also qualifying and guiding them to a sale. It allows businesses to use WhatsApp effectively as a channel to sell online. Users can personalize conversations with them at scale – so they can engage, qualify, and convert them in real-time, day or night.

about_short_description.short_description: ZOKO connects businesses to Whatsapp and Facebook Messenger for sending notifications, marketing, and conversational commerce.

product.name: WhatsApp Catalog
product.description: Synchronizes Shopify store catalogs with WhatsApp to enable product sales directly within WhatsApp chats.

product.name: WhatsApp Broadcasts
product.description: Enables businesses to send personalized bulk messages to customers on WhatsApp for marketing and engagement.

product.name: Zoko Flows (Flow Builder)
product.description: A tool to create automated multi-step workflows on WhatsApp for tasks like order confirmations and customer support.

product.name: Recover Abandoned Checkouts Flow
product.description: Automated WhatsApp workflow that sends reminders to customers to complete abandoned Shopify checkouts.

product.name: COD Confirmation Flow
product.description: Automates confirmation of cash-on-delivery orders via WhatsApp to reduce cancellations and shipping costs.

product.name: Shopify Notifications Integration
product.description: Automatically sends Shopify order notifications and updates to customers via WhatsApp.
